title: TensorPlate Backend Capability
description: Vendor-neutral capability record published by every registered execution backend adapter (V01-E05-F01). Consumed by bundle validation, status reporting, and the adapter conformance harness. Mirrors `tensorplate::BackendCapability` in `include/tensorplate/backend/capability.hpp` and exists so that capability records can cross process boundaries without leaking adapter-specific types.

backend_name.description: Stable adapter key (e.g. `tensorrt`, `libtorch`, `python_pytorch`). Matches the BackendRegistry key under which the adapter is registered.

profile_id.description: Optional backend-specific profile identifier (e.g. TensorRT optimization-profile name).

supported_precision.description: PrecisionHint values the adapter accepts in `ModelSpec.precision_hint`. Stable snake_case wire names mirroring the enum in model_spec.json.

shape_support.description: How strictly the adapter constrains input tensor shapes.

supports_async.description: True iff the adapter implements native async (`do_infer_async`); v0.1.0 baseline adapters default to false.

op_coverage_score_pct.description: Coarse percentage of model ops the adapter can execute (e.g. for ONNX coverage warnings).

memory_estimate_bytes.description: Adapter-published static memory estimate. Must be <= memory_limit_bytes if both are set.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Adapter-published hard memory ceiling, when known.

target_compatibility_notes.description: Free-form target/hardware notes (e.g. `requires Jetson Orin`, `Vitis AI DPU only`).
